title: Starts with ab: a dead state collects labels for nothing
notes: q3 is a dead state: no arrow leaves it. In name order it goes last, so it picks up labels from s all the way, and then they all vanish, because no path from it reaches f. Fewest paths first would rip it at once.
ops: start q0; accept q2; q0 a -> q1; q0 b -> q3; q1 a -> q3; q1 b -> q2; q2 a,b -> q2; q3 a,b -> q3
